threads.body: [General] This pattern is not restricted to the first line of the block as documented: `find()` will skip the entire `pass` block when the marker appears anywhere later in its body, including in an unrelated explanatory comment. Anchor the marker to the start of the captured block so only the documented placement is honored.

replies.body: I think it might be better to relax the wording and say that the comment has to appear in the pass block
